definition_en: Quintile (fifth) of household consumption per capita, Q1 the poorest fifth to Q5 the richest fifth. Whether the ranking is done nationally or within area, and whether it is population- or household-weighted, is an open decision: to be confirmed.
notes: Ranking level (national vs. within-area) and weighting to be confirmed.

definition_en: Decile (tenth) of household market income, D01 the poorest tenth to D10 the richest tenth, used for fiscal incidence analysis. Ranks households by market income, so its ordering differs from QUINT, which ranks by consumption per capita.
Sex of the household head: female or male.

Age group of the household head, split into below and at-or-above a cutoff age. The cutoff is unconfirmed: the category codes (LT35 / GE35) put it at 35, but the dashboard's existing label implies 29 or 30 (H17); to be confirmed.
notes: Cutoff age unconfirmed: codes say 35, dashboard label implies 29 or 30 (H17).

definition_en: Whether the household is poor, at the poverty line named by the POVLINE qualifier (and, where relevant, the PPP round named by the PPP qualifier) of the same observation.
Number of non-agricultural household enterprises operated by the household: 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4 or more.
Whether the person was employed at any time in the 12 months before the survey, or not employed.
Broad sector of the employed person's main job under ISIC Rev.4: AGR is section A; IND is sections B to F; SER is sections G to U.

Section of the employed person's main job under ISIC Rev.4, sections A to U. The universe is unconfirmed: the legacy label reads 'HH workers' (H5), so whether this covers all employed persons or a narrower group (e.g. household-enterprise workers only) is to be confirmed.
notes: Universe unconfirmed: legacy label says 'HH workers' (H5).

definition_en: Wage employment versus non-wage employment (self-employment and unpaid family work), classified under the international classification of status in employment (ICSE).
Whether the person's employment is formal (Y) or informal (N). The universe is unconfirmed (H6): to be confirmed.
Sex of the main owner of the non-agricultural household enterprise.
Whether the main owner of the non-agricultural household enterprise is married.
